long_biography.plain_text:
Arkady Romanovich Rotenberg studied physical education in Leningrad and spent more than fifteen years coaching judo and sambo before entering business. He and his younger brother Boris established SMP Bank, but Arkady's principal wealth developed through construction and infrastructure.

In the late 2000s, Arkady became an owner of SGM Group and Mostotrest, building a portfolio centred on pipelines, roads and large civil works. He sold SGM to a Gazprom subsidiary in 2019 and had previously transferred several assets out of his ownership, so those interests are historical rather than current. Mostotrest remains under Rotenberg's control through TFK-Finance. Vizant Group adds a growing hotel-management and development portfolio, broadening his holdings without displacing construction as the durable source of wealth.

uncertainties: Arkady Romanovich Rotenberg, born in 1951, is distinct from his younger brother Boris Romanovich Rotenberg, born in 1957, and from Igor Arkadyevich Rotenberg. Their assets and roles are not interchangeable.

SGM Group is a historical holding. Arkady created the group, held a majority interest while Boris held a minority share, later reached full ownership and exited its capital in 2019. The dossier does not present either brother as its current owner.

Arkady previously transferred Gazprom Drilling, a Mostotrest stake and a real-estate interest out of his ownership. Those transferred assets are not counted as current holdings, even where they remain associated with the Rotenberg name.

Forbes says Arkady agreed to transfer Mostotrest shares to a joint venture. Mostotrest's current ownership page instead identifies TFK-Finance, controlled by Arkady, as key shareholder; the dossier follows the current first-party ownership statement while preserving the earlier transfer plan as context.

Construction & Engineering remains the primary industry because Mostotrest is the largest clearly documented current operating interest. Vizant's hotels and the indirect airport stake add Hospitality and Aviation exposure without reliable evidence that either is larger.

Investor is used for the current relationship because Arkady now controls a portfolio across Mostotrest and Vizant after selling the founder-operated SGM platform. This does not imply personal ownership of every subsidiary property or affiliate asset.

Self-made uses the broad classification because Forbes identifies a self-created fortune and his career progressed from coaching into business. The starting circumstances are not assessed closely enough to choose independent or advantaged start without entering excluded political material.
